**Prerequisites (all form state), each listed separately.**

1. R -> A. `policy_source`: "A payment toward an unpaid fare is not taken until the fare charge carries a refund-offset settlement entry giving toll not incurred as its reason wherever a toll was charged on a trip whose fare was recalculated without any rider route change." Verbatim in R's hub, "Conditions on fixing the payment amount" para 1; connective "not taken until", state form intact; in no other document. Basis: A's hub "booked as a refund-offset settlement entry against the unpaid fare charge, giving toll not incurred as its reason" (same words) + records (toll ade38247 E-470, fare basis recalculated, no route change, no settlement on 0cfccd49). Strength: hard gate in both.
2. R -> B. `policy_source`: "The unpaid-fare payment amount is fixed only after a fare recalculated without any rider route change carries a refund-offset settlement entry giving route inefficiency as its reason." Verbatim in R's hub para 2; in no other document. Basis: B's hub "booked only as a refund-offset settlement entry against that fare charge, giving route inefficiency as its reason" + records. Same strength.
3. R -> C. `policy_source`: "The unpaid-fare payment amount is not fixed before any detour delay on a trip whose fare was recalculated without a rider route change stands as a submitted fare review giving route inefficiency as its reason." Verbatim in R's hub para 3; in no other document. Basis: C's hub "refers the detour delay to the fare review team as a fare review against the fare charge, giving route inefficiency as its reason" + tool "in submitted status" + records (44 > 26 minutes, no reviews). Same strength.
- A, B, C documents carry none of R's sentences and do not mention the payment. `condition` / `resolved_by` / `effect` appear nowhere.

## bijection_verdict

**PASS.** No previous revision.

Policy-side notes (not KB verdicts):
1. payment_collection_settings_0068569c carries the base parameter description of `outstanding_balance_blocks_requests` ("whether a rider with any unpaid trip amount may not request or reserve a new trip until it is settled") unchanged, while R's replacement exempts an amount held out against a submitted review. The overwrite retired the hold clause of the base rule but not the parameter description; the KB carries base text as it stands. Read together with the hub ("any other unpaid amount still blocks") there is no contradiction a solver must adjudicate in this task, but the wording "any unpaid trip amount" is broader than the current basis.
2. The honoured-quote factor reads Plus Monthly's discount percent/options (Wayfare Pass figures, Pass corpus unpublished at audit time); here the records pin them (recorded 2.35 = 5% of the recalculated fare excluding booking fee), so the solution is unique today. pass.yaml confirms Plus Monthly 5% on [Wayfare Comfort, Wayfare Black].

## dependency_form

Sweep: all 65 documents read in full; tool-name sweep; prerequisite-sentence sweep; titles/openings reviewed.
- The three prerequisite sentences stand verbatim only in R's hub. The heading "Conditions on fixing the payment amount" groups R's own three sentences in R's own document and names no other problem, tool or order among them; it is the source's own carriage, not an aggregated route.
- No other problem's tool name outside its own invocation block; no route, checklist, ordered step list across A/B/C/R; no FAQ or contrast crossing problems.
- Titles general; none mirrors Owen's request ("Unpaid Wayfare Rides Fares: Payment With a Newly Added Payment Method" names the on_request subject).
- Depended-on documents reachable by the records' and sentences' words ("refund-offset settlement entry", "toll not incurred", "route inefficiency", "fare review").
- Blind hop marks: R -> A, R -> B, R -> C all state-derived.

Observations recorded (judged not RED; listed so the coordinator can weigh them):
- member_detour_credit_76f65801, "Cases": "Active membership with $119.94 in fee charges in the last 6 months: $2.00." $119.94 equals this task's evidence sum (six Plus Monthly fees of $19.99, 2026-04-12 … 09-12). It is framed as a hypothetical tier case, is the natural six-fee total of the Plus Monthly price, and states no tier for any customer; it did not pre-solve the blind derivation (the tier was reached from pass_events).
- payment_history_factors_613a7202, "Cases": "A rider whose Wayfare Pass fee was declined once four months ago and never since: none in the last 3 months, 1.0." This matches the shape of this task's near-miss (decline 2026-05-12, ~4 months before frozen time). Framed as a hypothetical window boundary; states the rule, not the customer's tier.
- unpaid_fare_payment_amount_fc604e6d worked example "Payment failure $31.62; settlement entries of $6.82 and $0.69" reuses the figures of the hypothetical worked examples in detour_fare_correction_amount_6dcea1f0 ($31.62 fare -> $6.82) and detour_toll_return_amount_76b60132 ($6.85 toll -> $0.69). The sentence itself states only the baseline's own semantics (settlement entries already booked reduce the unpaid amount left) and names no problem or order; a reader who cross-matches the numbers could see one hypothetical trip pass through three problems. Not RED under "what a sentence states"; flagged as a shared-example coincidence.

**PASS.**
